summary: Practise transaction structuring, document controls and payment monitoring. Explore the course and strengthen your trade-finance workflow.
lede: Trade and supply-chain finance covers structuring funding linked to trade and supplier payments, then controlling documents, approvals and settlement. For trade-finance and corporate-banking professionals, business finance teams, and supply-chain finance practitioners, it develops skills in mapping payment flows, checking documentary-credit and collection documents, and assessing buyer-supplier exposure. Participants also practise applying Incoterms 2020 responsibilities and monitoring exceptions through settlement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, support or oversee financing decisions tied to trade documents, receivables and supplier payments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with trade finance, corporate banking, business finance or supplier-payment operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
